alec: FYI CI perf alert on a100-nightly — small-batch tail latency +35% after last nvcc/PTX roll. Observed nondeterministic kernel selection: matmul_v4 sometimes picked over matmul_v2, huge latency delta.

alec: Quick profiler snippet:
```
matmul_v4_kernel  67.1ms  occupancy 57%  workspace_alloc 42MB
matmul_v2_kernel  21.8ms  occupancy 98%  workspace_alloc 8MB
KV cache hits dropped ~12% in the same window
```

nina: ugh. Which commit/PR changed the nvcc flags? PR id?

alec: looks like the nightly bumped nvcc to 12.18.4 and a build rule reordered ptx layout (commit 3b7ac9a). CI link: https://ci/internal/3412345

jinwoo: can we bisect against the compiler change? I'll kick off a bisect job. command I'll use:
```
git bisect start -- bad HEAD -- good origin/nightly~10
git bisect run ./tools/ci/run_smallbatch_bench.sh --device a100
```

ci-bot: perf-regression: smallbatch-tail-latency spike detected (35%) on a100-nightly (job 9898)

maria: quick perf trace shows extra workspace allocs and an extra memcpy phase when matmul_v4 chosen. KV prefetch scheduling gets pushed, KC cache churn increases. flame snippet:
```
0.0s - dispatch
0.02s - matmul_v4_kernel (alloc+memcpy)
0.09s - kv_reload
```

alec: thanks. I want a fast mitigation: we can force kernel selector to prefer matmul_v2 for small-seq shapes via env override. Patch in systemd template:
```
Environment=REDWOOD_FORCE_MATMUL=matmul_v2
```

jinwoo: note forcing may increase peak memory on heavy batches. suggest canary only to avoid OOMs everywhere.

maria: started bisect, current suspect commit found: 3b7ac9a -> nvcc change. Reproduces locally on a100: yes. Next: reproduce with reduced repro and file bug upstream.

alec: opening rollback PR to pin selector priority and block the rollout until we have upstream confirmation. tagging as rollout-blocker :no_entry_sign:

ops-bot: canary hold applied to canary pool (hosts: canary-1..3). Re-run perf jobs.

jinwoo: CI re-run shows tail latency returned to baseline on canary. leaving follow-up to maria for upstream bug filing and longer bisect.

maria: filing upstream bug with reduced repro + perf logs. assigning to compiler team. Will update thread when we have a patch.

alec: thanks team — good catch. Keep the canary hold until we get an upstream fix or we replace the emitted PTX layout.
